request_phase.name: first_request_to_last_response
request_phase.method: Request perf_counter timestamps mapped to wall time by mean of controller start/end clock offsets.

scope: Five native H/O matrix operations per valid chunk/value-head/layer/rank; local heads=16.
limitations: Dense MNK arithmetic is not useful causal or triangular arithmetic; do not add it to the semantic subtotal.
Internal Cube alignment/padding, vector stages, chunk WY/KKT, inverse, convolution and preprocessing are excluded.
Shapes come from host descriptors and manifest-linked source, not device-side operand sampling.
These are reference-shape candidates, not calibrated capacities or a frozen full-model reference.
